method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 36's east edge prints 'AVENUE L' vertically; its last block column carries the even Ave L frontage 1602-1628 and street numbers 1102-1124 / 1101-1123. Sheet 37's west edge prints 'AVENUE L' and its first block column carries the odd frontage 1601-1627 with street numbers 1202-1224 / 1201-1223. Even/odd facades of the same avenue plus the 1100/1200 change fix it; Avenue K (36, one block west) and Avenue M (37, one block east) are separately labelled.
